Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

  • Administrar os principais ambientes de computação em nuvem (cloud computing) da empresa: gerenciar Google Cloud, AWS e similares, provisionar recursos para novos projetos, manter segurança e organização dos acessos, atuando como ponto focal técnico da infraestrutura de cloud, inclusive em colaboração com laboratórios parceiros;

  • Apoiar operações físicas relacionadas a dispositivos e equipamentos: organizar trocas de máquinas, recebimento e envio de equipamentos, formatação, etc, garantindo rastreabilidade e histórico;
  • Colaborar na virtualização e permissionamento de infraestrutura compartilhada com laboratórios parceiros: garantindo segurança e compatibilidade técnica com os padrões da Kunumi;
  • Garantir rastreabilidade e preparação para auditorias: assegurar que os processos executados sejam documentados e auditáveis, especialmente em relação à segurança de dados, gestão de acessos e governança digital;
  • Mapear e manter atualizados os fluxos e relatórios de controle: criar e alimentar documentos internos que orientem o processo de acessos e apoiem colegas, além de organizar dados de uso, devoluções e status de ferramentas.

O que é esperado de você

  • Experiência com Google Cloud e/ou AWS em contexto de provisionamento e controle de acessos.
  • Conhecimento sobre segurança da informação aplicadas à gestão de identidades e permissões.
  • Facilidade para navegar por múltiplos sistemas e fluxos simultâneos (ex: onboarding, solicitações, controle de acessos).
  • Experiência lidando com dados sensíveis, acessos privilegiados e responsabilidades críticas.
  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação com áreas diversas.

O que pode ser considerado um diferencial

  • Vivência com processos de acesso em ambientes regulados (saúde, finanças, etc).
  • Perfil autodidata, com facilidade para aprender novos sistemas e processos sem depender de treinamento formal.
  • Conhecimento básico de programação ou automações (ex: scripts, integrações leves).
  • Conforto para atuar em ambientes com baixa estrutura formal, exigindo proatividade, autonomia, senso crítico e autoconhecimento.

Na Kunumi, a curiosidade é nossa força motriz na busca incansável por conhecimento e pela coragem de desafiar o convencional. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas é fundamental para criar soluções únicas e impactantes.

Nossa cultura é pautada pela valorização das pessoas, do cuidado com o legado que deixamos e pela constante busca por resultados elegantes em meio a desafios complexos. Aqui, cada voz é ouvida, cada ideia é valorizada e cada conquista é celebrada em conjunto.

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Director of Change Management to join our team! On a typical day, you might:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies aligned with agency goals, including process redesigns, organizational restructuring, technology adoption, and cultural shifts.
  • Establish and maintain a proven change management methodology and toolkit to ensure consistency, effectiveness, and measurable results across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define the scope of change initiatives and ensure seamless integration.
  • Build and lead a high-performing team of change management practitioners and project managers.
  • Develop and implement change communication strategies that inform, engage, and motivate employees at all levels to embrace change.
  • Monitor and measure the effectiveness of change management initiatives, adjusting strategies as needed based on feedback and results.

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.

  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Minimum of three (3) years of project management and/or program development experience in Human Services, Public Health, Human Resources, or Education field.
  • Certificate in Change Management (e.g., Prosci, ACMP, or similar).
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Organizational Development, Human Resources, Human Services, or related field.
  • Supervision of two (2) or more employees.

  • Minimum of one (1) year of experience in change management, organizational development or transformation roles with proven track record of leading large-scale change initiatives across diverse teams, functions, and geographies.

Deadline for Application: October 30, :59pm

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties

About GoodParty.org :

GoodParty.org is on a mission to make people matter more than money in our democracy by empowering Independent candidates to run, win, and serve. Our AI-powered platform provides free tools to Independent candidates to run their campaigns, connect with voters, and serve their communities effectively.

A majority of eligible voters, including more than half of Millennials and Gen Z, say that neither Republicans nor Democrats represent them. GoodParty.org is the solution. In 2024 we empowered 3,444 Independent candidate wins across 48 states from all across the ideological spectrum. The elected officials we empower prioritize people over parties and community over corporate interests. In 2024, 40.3 million votes (26% of all voters) cast a ballot for our candidate users. We’re not a political party; we’re a platform and a movement to democratize democracy.

Founded by serial entrepreneur Farhad Mohit, GoodParty.org is building solutions so we can have a truly representative democracy where society’s biggest problems are solved.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and coach a team of contract outreach reps by coordinating daily/weekly priority call lists, setting pipeline goals, and ensuring high-quality, high-impact conversations.
  • Create and refine recommended talk tracks, email templates, call scripts, and objection handling guides to improve outreach conversion and candidate quality.
  • Monitor outreach performance and call quality, providing insights or resources to help reps improve results.
  • Own and execute candidate outreach at the top of the funnel, introducing prospective independent and nonpartisan candidates to GoodParty.org and sparking their interest in running for office using our tools.
  • Drive initial engagement by clearly communicating our mission, platform benefits, and the unique value of running independently with GoodParty.org’s support.
  • Manage a high-volume outreach pipeline in HubSpot, maintaining accurate records, tracking engagement, and ensuring consistent, personalized follow-ups.
  • When bandwidth allows, make outreach calls to contribute to top-of-funnel goals.
  • Pilot and implement new messaging strategies, tools, and AI enhancements – testing what works and scaling what doesn’t across the team.
  • Share top-of-funnel insights with internal teams to help inform platform positioning, marketing strategy, candidate personas, and product messaging.
  • Bring a startup mindset to everything you do by experimenting, learning fast, and iterating to drive candidate pipeline growth and readiness.
  • Report to the Senior Sales Manager who oversees all sales teams.

Who we’re looking for

  • You're up for the audacious challenge of driving money out of politics and democratizing democracy.
  • You have 4-5 years of experience in outreach, sales, or business development, 2+ years in tech sales with 1+ years experience as a team lead.
  • You're skilled at building trust with team members, moving conversations toward action.
  • You explain complex tools simply and clearly, and communicate expectations with confidence and empathy.
  • You're organized, self-directed, and comfortable managing pipelines in HubSpot while hitting engagement goals.
  • You're tech-savvy and already using AI tools that boost performance.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, remote, startup environment where you can make things happen without a lot of red tape.
  • You've trained or coached team members on talk tracks, objection handling, or outreach strategies.

Bonus if

  • You've used your outreach or sales skills in a social impact, nonprofit, or political environment, either professionally or as a volunteer.
  • You've built or optimized CRM workflows, automation sequences, or reporting dashboards—especially in high-volume outreach teams.
  • You've worked in civic tech, political campaigns, or democracy-focused initiatives and understand the unique challenges of this space.
  • You've deployed AI tools for outreach (e.g. call summarizers, email generators, or LLMs) to improve efficiency and personalization.

Why you should work at GoodParty.org

  • Join us in solving the biggest problem of our time – fixing our democracy – so all other problems can be solved.
  • We’re a Public Benefit Corporation that prioritizes social impact over profit.
  • Innovative Bitcoin-denominated deferred bonus plan, allowing you to have the amazing upside of being in a startup while working on a truly meaningful mission.
  • Work where and how you like, on a fully remote team spread across the country.
  • Join a passionate team with diverse political views focused on one mission.
  • 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents.
  • We encourage you to take time off to recharge and have an unlimited PTO policy.
  • 401(k) program available (no employer match).
  • Individual learning & development budget to fund your growth.
  • Workspace setup stipend to support remote work; $50/month for home internet if you work from home. Co-working can be discussed as an option.
  • Fully funded for our mission. No stress over funding rounds; focus on impact.

title: Sr. Medical Director, Gastrointestinal and Inflammation (Remote)
description:
About the role

Join Takeda as a Senior Medical Director, Pharmacovigilance in Gastrointestinal and Inflammation (GI²). You will oversee medical safety activities and processes for assigned products, ensuring continuous assessment of safety profiles and benefit-risk of investigational and marketed compounds.

You will provide strategic, patient-focused leadership for medical safety, support asset strategies, and strengthen medical and scientific innovation. Timely escalation of safety issues to the Takeda Safety Board Chair is required. You will define and implement a vision for Patient Safety, enhance medical safety capabilities, and be a core member of company-wide Committees and Governance.

As part of the Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV) team, you will report to the Vice President, Therapeutic Area Head of Gastrointestinal and Inflammation PSPV. You may manage/oversee physicians and Health Care Professionals (HCPs) serving as Global Safety Leaders (GSL) and PV Scientists for a compound that is both in clinical development and marketed in the designated therapeutic area.

How you will contribute

  • May directly manage a group of GSLs and PV Scientists responsible for overseeing the medical safety profile for assigned products.

  • Interacts with and influences colleagues from other functions to ensure the successful development, design and implementation of comprehensive safety and benefit-risk assessment strategies for products.

  • Oversees signal detection and risk management activities for assigned products and ensures that development plans include comprehensive safety assessment plans.

  • Flexible to support compounds/initiatives outside of primary therapeutic area(s) as directed by business and departmental needs

  • Leads PSPV Safety Team (GST) and Safety Management Team (SMT) for assigned GI compounds and products.

  • Represents the cross-functional program team as a product safety profile and risk mitigation expert for internal (e.g., Takeda Safety Board) and external (e.g., Independent Data Monitoring Committee) stakeholders.

  • Manages cross-functional assessment of benefit-risk profile and communication of safety information for assigned compounds and products.

  • Leads the interpretation of safety data from internal and external sources, assessment of ensuing scientific and medical implications, and communication of the impact of same both in terms of “go/no go” decisions or modification of development plan or study design, including potential impact on timeline or product labeling, ensuring the primacy of patient safety.

  • Mentors GSLs and PV Scientists with respect to compounds in development and marketed drugs, safety monitoring and risk management assessment and analysis.

  • Supports cross-functional team evaluations in preparation for presentations to the Takeda Safety Board and similar forums. The Senior Medical Director will be a key player in the preparation and presentation of materials to the Takeda Safety Board and similar forums.

  • Manages the reactive response to emerging safety signals.

  • May perform the medical safety evaluation of projects for new business development opportunities (e.g., due diligence evaluations).

  • Ensures high quality analyses of safety information, in support of safety update regulatory submissions, investigational and new drug applications and interactions with regulatory authorities worldwide.

  • Assists the Global Medical Safety GI Therapeutic Area Head in assessing the implications of emerging regulatory intelligence and developing strategies for adapting processes and procedures.

  • Oversees risk management plans for compounds in development and marketed drugs.

  • Ensures that GSLs are proactively identifying safety concerns and developing contingency strategies that address these challenges.

  • Maintains professional knowledge and accreditation by active participation in continuing medical education activities and fosters a community of continual learning.

Minimum Requirements/Qualifications

  • Medical Degree (MD) required or internationally recognized equivalent ideally combined with Advanced Degree.

  • 8 years+ of experience gained in Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Research, or Clinical Development within the Pharmaceutical industry and/or academia and/or CRO including significant experience in operating in a global pharmacovigilance organization.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in people management.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of regulatory agency requirements regarding drug safety and an understanding of general drug safety methodologies.

  • Ability to comprehend and synthesize complex data and should have experience in the identification, analysis, and implementation of programs and procedures required to achieve corporate objectives.

  • Experience operating in a multi-disciplinary drug development environment including international experience and exposure to a variety of therapeutic areas.

  • Identifies opportunities and anticipates changes in the medical safety landscape through an understanding and ongoing assessment of the environment affecting the Patient.

  • Must have demonstrable experience in people management at a leadership level and well-developed skills in team building, motivating, empowering, and developing people.

  • Work productively in a fast-moving and pressured environment.

  • Good analytical/judgment capabilities to understand, analyze/synthesize and communicate successfully and concisely

  • Well-developed time management skillset to assist in prioritization of multiple issues

  • Computer literate, including safety database acumen

  • Self-resourced, with the confidence to take the initiative and act autonomously

  • Both facilitate and efficiently lead meetings, both in person and in other media

  • Excellent communication skillset, orally and presentational

  • Proven ability to work globally and cross-functionally, with strong interpersonal skills /appropriately assertive /team-minded and mentoring.

More about us

At Takeda, we are transforming patient care through the development of novel specialty pharmaceuticals and best in class patient support programs. Takeda is a patient-focused company that will inspire and empower you to grow through life-changing work.

Certified as a Global Top Employer, Takeda offers stimulating careers, encourages innovation, and strives for excellence in everything we do. We foster an inclusive, collaborative workplace, in which our teams are united by an unwavering commitment to deliver Better Health and a Brighter Future to people around the world.

This position is currently classified as "remote" in accordance with Takeda\'s Hybrid and Remote Work policy.

Takeda Compensation and Benefits Summary

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. We are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices.

For Location: Massachusetts - Virtual

U.S. Base Salary Range: $257,600.00 - $404,800.00

The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The actual base salary offered may depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. The actual base salary offered will be in accordance with state or local minimum wage requirements for the job location.

U.S. based employees may be eligible for short-term and/ or long-term incentives. U.S. based employees may be eligible to participate in medical, dental, vision insurance, a 401(k) plan and company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, a tuition reimbursement program, paid volunteer time off, company holidays, and well-being benefits, among others. U.S. based employees are also eligible to receive, per calendar year, up to 80 hours of sick time, and new hires are eligible to accrue up to 120 hours of paid vacation.

Overview

SOBRE A BUZZCREATORS
A Buzzcreators é uma plataforma brasileira especializada em conectar marcas com influenciadores, especialmente micro e nano influenciadores, para a criação e gestão de campanhas de marketing de influência. Ela oferece uma solução automatizada e baseada em dados para facilitar todo o processo, desde o planejamento até a execução e pagamento das campanhas.

Vaga - 100% HOME OFFICE

O que buscamos

O SDR em vendas (Sales Development Representative, ou Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas) terá a responsabilidade de identificar e qualificar leads, estabelecer contatos, criar oportunidades de negócio e auxiliar os times comerciais. Além disso, atuará na etapa pré-vendas, com habilidades específicas, antes de as vendas começarem.

Atividades

  • Prospecção ativa 100% focada em Outbound de empresas e agências interessadas e com potencial para se tornarem clientes Buzzmonitor;
  • Compreensão das necessidades/dores de negócio do cliente;
  • Apresentação de plataforma para solucionar essas necessidades;
  • Mapeamento de necessidades e potenciais projetos.

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino superior em andamento ou completo;
  • Experiência na posição de SDR/Inside Sales;
  • Experiência com metodologia de venda BANT;
  • Experiência com Google Docs ou Microsoft Office;
  • Experiência com processo outbound;
  • Experiência com criação de listas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Técnica de vendas: Spin Selling;
  • Prospecção ABM;
  • Experiência no setor de Marketing Digital;
  • Experiência com Atendimento (SAC 4.0);
  • Experiência com tecnologia ou software SaaS;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de captação de cliente e validação de email (Sales Engagement).

title: Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
Title: Chief Financial Officer

Location: Remote

About The Princeton Review

The Princeton Review (TPR) is a leading tutoring, test prep, and college admission services company. Every year, it helps millions of college- and graduate school–bound students achieve their education and career goals through online and in-person courses delivered by a network of more than 4,000 teachers and tutors, online resources, and its more than 150 print and digital books published by Penguin Random House. The company’s Tutor.com brand is one of the largest online tutoring services in the U.S. It comprises a community of thousands of tutors who have delivered more than 28 million one-to-one tutoring sessions. The Princeton Review is headquartered in New York, NY. Follow the company on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram.

About the Position

We’re seeking a strategic and results-driven Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead The Princeton Review and Tutor.com’s financial strategy, planning, and business operations. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the CFO will be a key member of the executive leadership team, responsible for shaping the financial future of the organization and ensuring fiscal discipline across all business units.

The CFO will oversee all aspects of financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, treasury, and compliance. This role will also oversee business operations including corporate real estate and supply chain. This role requires a visionary leader who can align financial strategy with organizational goals, drive operational efficiency, and support sustainable growth. The CFO will work closely with senior leaders across departments to provide data-driven insights, guide investment decisions, and ensure the company maintains a strong financial foundation to serve its diverse student populations.

This is a pivotal role with significant impact on the company’s performance, requiring a blend of strategic foresight, operational excellence, and collaborative leadership.

What You\'ll Do

As Chief Financial Officer, you will lead the financial strategy and operations of The Princeton Review and Tutor.com, ensuring the organization’s fiscal health and supporting its long-term growth. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Strategic Financial Leadership: Develop and execute financial strategies that align with the company’s mission, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Financial Planning & Analysis: Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes to ensure financial sustainability and performance.
  • Reporting & Compliance: Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, compliance with regulatory requirements, and successful completion of audits.
  • Treasury & Capital Management: Manage cash flow, banking relationships, and capital allocation to optimize financial resources and support strategic investments.
  • Executive Collaboration: Partner with the CEO and executive team to provide financial insights and support data-driven decision-making across departments.
  • Operational Oversight: Lead business operations including corporate real estate and supply chain, driving efficiency and cost-effectiveness across the enterprise.
  • Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Technology & Systems: Oversee financial systems and tools, driving automation and scalability to support a growing and dynamic organization.

Who You Are

  • A seasoned financial executive with 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in corporate finance, and ideally within multi-unit or service-based organizations.
  • The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in financial planning and analysis, accounting, treasury, and compliance, with a proven track record driving strategic growth and operational efficiency.
  • Successfully led finance teams through periods of transformation and are adept at aligning financial strategy with business objectives.
  • Possess strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and engage stakeholders at all levels, including board members and investors.
  • Data-driven decision-maker, skilled in leveraging financial analytics to guide investment decisions, manage risk and optimize performance.
  • Experienced in managing complex budgets, forecasting models, and financial systems, and have overseen audits, regulatory reporting, and capital planning.
  • Collaborative and inclusive leader who builds high-performing teams and fosters a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable operating in dynamic environments and bringing a strategic mindset with hands-on operational capabilities.

What We Offer

The Princeton Review is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Princeton Review’s policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. The Princeton Review also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also The Princeton Review’s policy to comply with all applicable laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.

To Apply

As part of your application, please include your resume and a thoughtful cover letter, addressed to Bob Batten outlining how your skills and experience meet the qualifications of the position.

The salary range for this role is $280k - 325K annually, commensurate incentive compensation

We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That’s why we’re on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and, above all, grow sustainably, without the hassle.

The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it’s no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations and contact management, drive leads, stabilize cash flow, and maximize revenue with minimal effort, so they can reclaim their time to focus on what they do best.

We aim to be the ultimate all-in-one platform for small business growth, allowing owners to manage every part of their business efficiently and effortlessly.

Our journey began as an agency, and we’ve already helped thousands of clients succeed. Now, we’re embracing an exciting new chapter: becoming a SaaS-first company. By combining hard-earned human expertise with AI and automation, we’re creating affordable solutions that give business owners peace of mind while driving measurable success.

At Olly Olly, we’re not just growing—we’re accelerating. We take immense pride in our culture of high-performing engineering and exceptional code quality. We have built a small business toolkit that has Generative AI at its core, and to help us scale this success, we are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Software Engineering Manager. This is a pivotal role that blends people leadership, project management, and hands-on technical contribution. You will guide up to two agile teams in delivering high-quality, full-stack features from concept to deployment for our core product: a multi-platform Flutter app available on iOS, Android, and the Web. We need a leader who can maintain our high engineering standards while we build fast, learn, and iterate.

description:
Agente de SAC - E-commerce (Vestuário) - Sazonal

Somos a 1° startup do Brasil a ter operações de Contact Center 100% no modelo home office.

Você é apaixonado por alcançar metas, está motivado a superar desafios e se colocar no lugar do outro enquanto faz parte de uma equipe dinâmica? Aqui é o seu lugar!!

Estamos à procura de profissionais dedicados, ambiciosos, apaixonados por alcançar metas e motivados a superar desafios para integrarem nossa equipe como Agentes de Atendimento, focados no SAC Multiskill para o e-commerce de uma marca de roupas e calçados.

Buscamos nos conectar com pessoas e aqui a gente preza pela igualdade de oportunidades e a inclusão da diversidade para todos os públicos. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Agente de solução em atendimento Multiskill via voz, ticket, e-mail e chat do e-commerce de uma rede de marcas de roupa de grife e calçados;
  • Você irá atender trocas e devoluções, estorno e reembolso;
  • Direcionar as reclamações e elogios recebidos aos setores/departamentos responsáveis;
  • Em todos os canais de comunicação é necessário ouvir atentamente o cliente buscando sempre o envolver, conduzir de forma prática o contato, possuir empatia, compreendendo a necessidade do cliente;
  • Nas mídias sociais será responsável por responder as reclamações e elogios dos clientes dos nossos anúncios.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência com atendimento em SAC de vestuário/e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento básico no ramo da moda;
  • Possuir agilidade, escrita e dicção boa;
  • Experiência com atendimento em multicanais – voz, chat e e-mail;
  • Possuir habilidades em atuar no modelo home office;
  • Ter um espaço adequado para atuar home office (Mesa, cadeira e ambiente sem ruído);
  • Residir em São Paulo/ Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencial em escritório no bairro Vila Olímpia sempre que requerido pela empresa/liderança;
  • Possuir internet cabeada com mais de 10 MB (Sem utilizar o Wifi);
  • Habilidade em manusear diversos plataformas de trabalho (Zendesk, WhatsApp, Telefone, chat e Pacote Office).

Informações adicionais

Escala de Trabalho: 6x1 – Horário a combinar de acordo com operação

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Auxilio Creche (Crianças de até 24 meses);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TotalPass;

Na Hitss, a inovação é o nosso combustível, a curiosidade é o nosso motor e o respeito pelo cliente é o nosso guia. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma cultura vibrante, onde a inovação é alimentada pela curiosidade incessante e onde o respeito pelo cliente permeia todas as nossas ações. Aqui, você terá a liberdade de explorar suas habilidades, colaborar com mentes brilhantes e transformar o futuro da tecnologia.

Se você está pronto para fazer parte de uma empresa que acredita que o talento é a chave para o sucesso, envie seu currículo e junte-se à nossa equipe.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e impulsionar juntos a próxima geração de soluções tecnológicas.

Venha ser um Hit!

Main responsibilities

Principais Atribuições:

  • Ser responsável pela condução do projeto através da alocação de recursos, ajuste das prioridades, coordenação das interações com analistas de negócios e usuários, além de manter a equipe do projeto na meta certa.
  • Estabelecer um conjunto de práticas que garantem a integridade e a qualidade dos artefatos do projeto;
  • Planejar, acompanhar, controlar, apoiar a execução e o encerramento dos projetos;
  • Elaborar o cronograma, orçamento e plano de trabalho para o projeto;
  • Elaborar e controlar o escopo do projeto junto ao cliente;
  • Gerenciar a análise de riscos – riscos de desenvolvimento, disponibilidade de recursos e tecnologia;
  • Gerenciar e controlar as mudanças do projeto.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos necessários:

  • Ensino Superior Completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou Nível Superior em qualquer área de formação com pós-graduação da área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos;
  • Conhecimento de diferentes metodologias como PMI (Project Management Institute), PRINCE2 (Projects IN Controlled Environments) e Agile;
  • Conhecimento em análise e gerenciamento de riscos, estimativa, planejamento e análise de decisões;

Requisitos desejáveis:

Possuir uma das certificações abaixo será um diferencial:

  • PMP (Project Management Professional);
  • CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Management);
  • PRINCE2;
  • Entre outas certificações reconhecidas internacionalmente.
